title.zh: 复盘：偏好可以暂定，也可以改口
title.en: Review a preference that may remain tentative

paragraphs.zh: 沿用不喜欢的桌游下一场，写一个更想玩的版本和一个也可接受的替代，再标清还不确定的部分。别人有不同偏好时，可讨论、少玩一段或不参加，不必把请求变成命令。可以只写虚构草稿。复盘看选择是否更清楚，不以说话果断或最终如愿证明自我价值、强大或恢复程度。
paragraphs.en: For the unwanted next tabletop scene, name a preferred version, an acceptable alternative and anything still uncertain. Different preferences may lead to discussion, a shorter part or declining without turning a request into an order. Draft fiction only. Review clearer choices without treating firmness or getting your way as worth, strength or recovery.

title.zh: 借原创桌游场景聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original tabletop scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果桌游下一场不是你喜欢的玩法，你会怎样说一个偏好、一个替代和一处仍不确定的地方？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If the next tabletop scene did not appeal, how would you name a preference, an alternative and something still uncertain?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。六个名字只对应本版选项，不测智力、健康、身份、勇气或超能力，也不把人物痛苦经历分派给你。对方可不了解作品、换角色、不回答或结束；不以结果猜创伤、关系或私人身份，不替缺席者贴标签。
paragraphs.en: Share the public guide without answers or counts in the link. Six names concern this edition’s options, assessing no intelligence, health, identity, courage or powers and assigning no painful fictional experiences. The other person may be unfamiliar with the story, change characters, decline or stop. Infer no trauma, relationships or private identity and label no absent person through a result.

title.zh: 复盘：重返入口不必抹掉之前的选择
title.en: Review rejoining without erasing earlier choices

paragraphs.zh: 沿用漏开场的朋友，先问现在是否想加入，再用两句回顾指出一个可进入的会合点。也可只旁观、改角色或留到下次，原来玩家的选择不必全部重来。可以只画邀请卡。复盘看入口是否好用、回应是否自由，不以全员到场评友情，也不默认你必须永久组织。
paragraphs.en: For a friend who missed the opening, ask whether they want to join and offer a two-sentence recap with one meeting point. Watching, changing roles or waiting until next time remain options without restarting everyone’s choices. Sketch an invitation card only. Review a usable entry and a free response, without grading friendship through attendance or assigning permanent organising duty.

title.zh: 借原创桌游场景聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original tabletop scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友漏了桌游开场，你会怎样留一个会合点，同时允许旁观、换角色或下次再来？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend missed the tabletop opening, how would you offer a meeting point with options to watch, change roles or join another time?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：意外连接先标为可选设定
title.en: Review an unexpected connection as an optional invention

paragraphs.zh: 沿用彩绘招牌和喜剧物件，编一个连接，再添一个完全不同的简单解释，两者都标为新点子。小组可选、合并或都不用；有趣不代表已经成立。可以只想两个标题。复盘看是否打开可玩的下一步，不把暗线多、猜中或别人发笑当智力、创造力和科学天分的分数。
paragraphs.en: For the painted sign and comic object, invent a connection and a different simple explanation, labelling both as new ideas. Choose, combine or ignore them; entertainment does not establish a fact. Imagine two titles only. Review a playable next step without scoring intelligence, creativity or scientific talent through hidden links, correct guesses or laughter.

title.zh: 借原创桌游场景聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original tabletop scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果要把招牌和一个喜剧物件连起来，你会提什么可选解释，又留什么简单版本供大家比较？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “To connect a sign and a comic object, which optional explanation would you offer and what simple alternative would you compare?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：一个回合只检查约定的问题
title.en: Review an agreed question through one turn

paragraphs.zh: 沿用没人试过的新规则，先写本回合要检查什么，再按现有措辞走一遍。若结果与预期不同，区分说明含糊、操作不同或规则本身需改；大家也可同意宽松玩法。只画一回合也可以。复盘看例子是否回答约定问题，不把规则检查看成辩赢、理性等级或不信朋友的理由。
paragraphs.en: For the untried rule, state what this turn checks and follow the current wording once. Distinguish ambiguous instructions, different actions and a rule worth changing if results differ from expectations. A looser agreement is also possible. Sketch a turn only. Review the agreed question rather than debate victory, a rationality ranking or distrust of friends.

title.zh: 借原创桌游场景聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original tabletop scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果桌游新规则没人试过，你会用哪一个普通回合检查它，又怎样决定是否需要修改？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For an untried tabletop rule, which ordinary turn would you use to check it and how would you decide whether to revise?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：画面是一种邀请，不是唯一版本
title.en: Review an image as an invitation rather than a fixed version

paragraphs.zh: 沿用平静屋子，选光线、一个形状和一件普通物品，快画或短写，再请愿意的伙伴改一处。两人的画面可不同，不用裁谁理解得更深。可以只想象，不展示作品。复盘看场景是否更容易共同进入，不用画得像、细节多或情绪强证明美术、共情、心理健康或内在生活。
paragraphs.en: For the peaceful room, choose light, a shape and an ordinary object, sketch or describe them briefly, and invite one change. Images may differ without deciding who understands more deeply. Imagine without showing work. Review easier shared entry into the scene, without treating likeness, detail or emotional intensity as art skill, empathy, mental health or an inner life.

title.zh: 借原创桌游场景聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original tabletop scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只用三个普通视觉细节描述平静屋子，你会选什么，再邀请别人改哪一处？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “With three ordinary visual details for a peaceful room, what would you choose and which change would you invite?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.

title.zh: 复盘：新路线与熟悉路线都可自选
title.en: Review both a new and familiar route as choices

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上次角色的再次邀请，分别想继续原角色与试小分支的版本，再写一个回到共同场景的办法。改主意或喜欢默认路线都可以，不必持续与众不同。可以只画路线。复盘看当下是否愿意、伙伴如何接上，不把分开多久或拒绝多少当独立分数，也不从角色推荐退出真实关系。
paragraphs.en: For the invitation to repeat a role, imagine continuing it and trying a small branch, with a way back to a shared scene. Changing your mind or liking the default remains possible without performing difference. Sketch routes only. Review present willingness and reconnection without grading independence through separation or refusal, or recommending withdrawal from real relationships through a character.

title.zh: 借原创桌游场景聊选择
title.en: Discuss choices through an original tabletop scene

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果大家邀你继续上次的桌游角色，你会怎样比较原路线和一个小分支，并约好会合方式？”各想一个做法，再借另一位角色的角度调整。可只构思，不必参加活动、公开经历或模仿剧情。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If invited to repeat a tabletop role, how would you compare the familiar route with a small branch and agree how to reconnect?” Suggest an action each and revise through another character angle. Imagine without attending, disclosing experiences or imitating the story.
